# مؤسسي هادئ

## Overview

A design identity for a web application in Arabic, written right-to-left. The tokens above are normative; `tokens.css`, `theme.css` (Tailwind v4) and `tokens.json` next to this file carry the same values for code. Where this file is silent, stay plain and consistent rather than decorative.

- Platform: web. Contrast target: WCAG AA (4.5:1 for body text).
- Button style: `button-solid`. Card style: `card-bordered`.
- Filled in automatically (refine freely, keep the tokens): `shadows`, `spacing`.
- Left to your judgment, within these tokens: `illustrations`, `empty-states`.

## Colors

Two modes share the same roles. In the tokens above the light value has the plain name (`primary`) and the dark value a `dark-` prefix (`dark-primary`). In code both live under one variable (`--color-primary` in tokens.css, `bg-primary` in Tailwind) that switches with the mode.

| Role | Light | Dark | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `primary` | #2563eb | #60a5fa | Main action fill (one main action per screen), selected states. |
| `on-primary` | #ffffff | #000000 | Text and icons on primary. |
| `secondary` | #7c3aed | #a78bfa | Second accent: badges, secondary highlights. |
| `on-secondary` | #ffffff | #000000 | Text and icons on secondary. |
| `accent-text` | #2563eb | #60a5fa | Links and accent-colored text on background and surface. |
| `background` | #ffffff | #0b1120 | Page background. |
| `surface` | #f8fafc | #111827 | Cards, inputs, panels and secondary buttons. |
| `on-surface` | #111827 | #f9fafb | Body text and headings. |
| `muted-text` | #4b5563 | #9ca3af | Captions, helper text, metadata. |
| `border` | #e5e7eb | #374151 | Dividers and decorative borders (not for control boundaries). |
| `success` | #15803d | #15803d | Success state: icons, borders, fills. |
| `warning` | #b45309 | #b45309 | Warning state: icons, borders, fills. |
| `danger` | #b91c1c | #b91c1c | Error and destructive state: icons, borders, fills. |
| `info` | #1d4ed8 | #1d4ed8 | Information state: icons, borders, fills. |
| `focus-ring` | #2563eb | #60a5fa | Keyboard focus outline. |
| `control-border` | #4b5563 | #9ca3af | Boundaries of inputs and secondary buttons. |

Measured contrast (WCAG 2). The AA target is 4.5:1 for body text and 3:1 for large text; focus rings and control borders need 3:1. A pair below the body-text target is marked and may carry large text only:

- **Light:** Text on primary `#ffffff on #2563eb: 5.17:1`; Text on secondary `#ffffff on #7c3aed: 5.7:1`; Body text on background `#111827 on #ffffff: 17.74:1`; Body text on surface `#111827 on #f8fafc: 16.96:1`; Muted text on surface `#4b5563 on #f8fafc: 7.22:1`; Accent text on background `#2563eb on #ffffff: 5.17:1`; Focus ring on background `#2563eb on #ffffff: 5.17:1`; Control border on background `#4b5563 on #ffffff: 7.56:1`.
- **Dark:** Text on primary `#000000 on #60a5fa: 8.26:1`; Text on secondary `#000000 on #a78bfa: 7.72:1`; Body text on background `#f9fafb on #0b1120: 18.02:1`; Body text on surface `#f9fafb on #111827: 16.98:1`; Muted text on surface `#9ca3af on #111827: 6.99:1`; Accent text on background `#60a5fa on #0b1120: 7.41:1`; Focus ring on background `#60a5fa on #0b1120: 7.41:1`; Control border on background `#9ca3af on #0b1120: 7.42:1`.

Status colors (success, warning, danger, info) are for icons, borders and fills. Use one as text only where it reaches 4.5:1 against both background and surface (shown: against the background):

- **Light:** success `#15803d on #ffffff: 5.02:1` (text allowed); warning `#b45309 on #ffffff: 5.02:1` (text allowed); danger `#b91c1c on #ffffff: 6.47:1` (text allowed); info `#1d4ed8 on #ffffff: 6.7:1` (text allowed).
- **Dark:** success `#15803d on #0b1120: 3.75:1` (not for text); warning `#b45309 on #0b1120: 3.75:1` (not for text); danger `#b91c1c on #0b1120: 2.91:1` (not for text); info `#1d4ed8 on #0b1120: 2.81:1` (not for text).

Focus ring: `--color-focus-ring` (Tailwind `outline-focus-ring`), the primary color when it reaches 3:1 against background and surface, otherwise a role with more contrast (accent text, then body text). Control boundaries: `--color-control-border` (Tailwind `border-control-border`), never the lighter decorative `border`. Both switch with the mode like every other color.

Eleven-step ramps for tints and shades, the same in both modes (50 lightest, 950 darkest; `--color-primary-50` ... `--color-primary-950` in tokens.css):

- **primary:** #eff6ff, #dbeafe, #bfdbfe, #93c5fd, #60a5fa, #3b82f6, #2563eb, #1d4ed8, #1e40af, #1e3a8a, #172554.
- **secondary:** #f5f3ff, #ede9fe, #ddd6fe, #c4b5fd, #a78bfa, #8b5cf6, #7c3aed, #6d28d9, #5b21b6, #4c1d95, #2e1065.
- **neutral:** #f9fafb, #f3f4f6, #e5e7eb, #d1d5db, #9ca3af, #6b7280, #4b5563, #374151, #1f2937, #111827, #030712.

## Typography

- **Heading:** Arabic **IBM Plex Sans Arabic**, then `system-ui, sans-serif`.
- **Body:** Arabic **IBM Plex Sans Arabic**, then `system-ui, sans-serif`.
- **Numerals:** Arabic **IBM Plex Sans Arabic**, then `system-ui, sans-serif`.


Fonts load from the Google Fonts files. tokens.css and theme.css load every font of the identity themselves with `@font-face` rules, so linking or importing either one is enough, wherever it comes among your stylesheets; add no Google Fonts links or `@import` lines for them. Only for the font stacks without either file, add these links to the `<head>` of every page:

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=IBM+Plex+Sans+Arabic&amp;display=swap">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=IBM+Plex+Sans+Arabic:wght@700&amp;display=swap">
```

Font stacks for code: `--font-heading`, `--font-body` and `--font-numerals` in tokens.css (Latin family first, so Latin text uses it and Arabic letters fall through to the Arabic family).

Line height: 1.7 for Arabic text and 1.5 for Latin text (`--line-height-ar`, `--line-height-en`). Arabic needs the extra height for its marks and descenders.

Type scale (base 16px, ratio 1.25): sm 12.8px, base 16px, lg 20px, xl 25px, 2xl 31.25px, 3xl 39.06px. Headings use weight 700, labels 600, body 400. Use only these sizes.

## Layout

Spacing comes from a 4px unit. Allowed steps, with the tokens.css variable and the Tailwind multiplier: 0px (`--space-0`, `p-0`), 4px (`--space-1`, `p-1`), 8px (`--space-2`, `p-2`), 12px (`--space-3`, `p-3`), 16px (`--space-4`, `p-4`), 24px (`--space-5`, `p-6`), 32px (`--space-6`, `p-8`), 48px (`--space-7`, `p-12`), 64px (`--space-8`, `p-16`). Use no other gaps: in Tailwind the number is a multiple of the unit, not the step index.

Lay out with logical properties only (`margin-inline-start`, `padding-inline-end`, `inset-inline-start`, `text-align: start`), so the same CSS works in both directions. Group related content in cards; keep the reading column comfortable (about 60-75 characters of Latin text).

## Elevation & Depth

Shadows per mode (CSS `box-shadow` values; `--shadow-sm|md|lg` in tokens.css). Dark values apply when the system prefers dark unless the page sets `<html data-theme="light">`, and always with `<html data-theme="dark">`.

- **Light:** sm `0px 1px 2px 0px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.06)`; md `0px 4px 12px 0px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.08)`; lg `0px 12px 32px -4px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.12), 0px 2px 4px 0px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05)`.
- **Dark:** sm no shadow; md `0px 4px 12px 0px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.6)`; lg `0px 12px 32px 0px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.7)`.

Use sm for controls, md for cards and menus, lg for dialogs. Where a mode has no shadow, separate layers with surface color and borders instead.

## Shapes

Corner radius: sm 4px (small controls, tags), md 8px (buttons, inputs), lg 12px (cards, dialogs), full for pills and avatars. An element is never rounder than the container around it.

## Components

Every component has a `-dark` twin in the tokens above with the dark colors.

- **Primary button:** primary fill, on-primary text, label-md, rounded md. One per screen.
- **Secondary button:** surface fill, accent-text text, 1px control-border outline, rounded md.
- **Card:** surface fill, on-surface text, rounded lg, 1px border or the md shadow.
- **Input field:** surface fill, on-surface text, 1px control-border outline, rounded md; muted-text for helper text and placeholders.
- **Badge:** secondary fill, on-secondary text, rounded full.
- **Link:** accent-text, underlined.
- **Focus:** every interactive element shows a 2px focus-ring outline with a 2px offset on keyboard focus (`:focus-visible`).
- **Status:** a status color as an icon, border or 8px dot next to the message; the message text stays on-surface.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do use the primary color for the single main action on each screen.
- Do keep body text at 4.5:1 or more (WCAG AA), and focus rings and control borders at 3:1 or more.
- Do use only the colors, sizes, radii, shadows and spacing steps defined here; if Tailwind is used, ignore its default palette and scales.
- Do use CSS logical properties (`margin-inline-start`, `padding-inline-end`, `inset-inline-start`), never `left` / `right`.
- Don't add letter-spacing, uppercase or italic to Arabic text.
- Don't add fonts, colors or icon sets that are not listed here.

## Iconography

Use the **lucide** icon set only, weight **regular**, **outline** style, with **none** container (no container (the icon alone)). Size icons with the text (1em to 1.25em) and color them with `currentColor`. Mirroring rules are in the Arabic & Direction section.

## Motion

Motion level: **subtle**. Short fades and color changes only: 120-180ms, ease-out. Movement at most 4px. Nothing loops.

Always honor `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`: then nothing moves (instant changes or plain fades under 100ms).

## Numbers & Calendar

Digits: **Western** (0123456789), also in Arabic text. Format numbers with `new Intl.NumberFormat("ar-u-nu-latn")` in Arabic text and `new Intl.NumberFormat("en-u-nu-latn")` in English text.

Numbers font: IBM Plex Sans Arabic draws the digits (`--font-numerals`). In tables and figures that must line up, use `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` (the numeric-md token).

Calendar: **Gregorian**. Format dates with `new Intl.DateTimeFormat("ar-u-ca-gregory-nu-latn")` in Arabic text and `new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-u-ca-gregory-nu-latn")` in English text.

## Arabic & Direction (العربي والاتجاه)

- Pages: `<html lang="ar" dir="rtl">`.
- Use logical properties only: `margin-inline-start` / `margin-inline-end`, `padding-inline-*`, `inset-inline-start` / `inset-inline-end`, `border-inline-*`, `text-align: start` / `end`. Never physical left / right values.
- Mirror in right-to-left: `arrow`, `chevron`, `undo`, `redo` (for example `.icon-arrow:dir(rtl) { scale: -1 1; }`: `:dir()` follows the nearest `dir`, so icons inside a left-to-right passage stay as they are, and the `scale` property keeps any other transform).
- Never mirror: `clock`, `play`, `check`, `media`.
- Arabic text: line height 1.7; no letter-spacing, uppercase or italic; never break or justify words letter by letter.
- Latin snippets inside Arabic text (emails, URLs, code, product names) go in `<bdi>` or an element with `dir="ltr"` (add `lang="en"` for English words), so their order stays correct.
